purpose: Screen code outputs against known targets of distinct geometric/statistical kinds.

non_dimension_signatures.PermutationEntropy: entropie normalisee (0,1], ancre de saturation dans la taxonomie, pas un d pour T_log
non_dimension_signatures.KolmogorovLZ: nombre de productions LZ76, non borne ; ancre de divergence relative, pas une dimension de Hausdorff
non_dimension_signatures.SpectralBeta: pente spectrale, signature null, pas un d
non_dimension_signatures.Hurst: exposant R/S ; la dimension de graphe 2-H est Hurst2mH / DFA
non_dimension_signatures.Lyapunov: exposant de Lyapunov, signature de stabilite, pas un d
non_dimension_signatures.MultifractalDeltaAlpha: largeur de spectre multifractal, signature null

benchmarks: fGn_H0.50 and fGn_H0.75: H and beta references, with the code's d transforms tested separately
fBm_graph_H0.50 and fBm_graph_H0.75: known graph dimension 2-H
torus_k1..k3: known manifold dimension k and smooth scalar graph dimension 1; PCA/Fisher outputs are descriptive because their participation ratios are not the rank 2k
torus_k4: stress test because several code embeddings are capped below the generic 2k+1 Takens bound

descriptive_only_estimators_on_torus.PCAIntrinsic: The code returns a covariance participation ratio; 2*k is only a possible linear rank, not a calibrated participation-ratio target.
descriptive_only_estimators_on_torus.Fisher: The code returns a covariance participation ratio; 2*k is only a possible linear rank, not a calibrated participation-ratio target.

screening_rules.note: Predeclared pilot tolerances are screening thresholds, not inferential pass/fail claims.

limitations: No noise or measurement irregularity is added; these are idealized data.
Finite records and only 5-8 replicates give a screening result, not a full calibration study.
The quasiperiodic signals are scalar delay observations; reconstruction quality depends on embedding dimension and delay.
A linear covariance effective dimension and a manifold intrinsic dimension are different targets even when both are numerical dimensions.
Non-dimensional signatures are retained and checked for finite outputs, but they are not forced to have a geometric dimension reference.
Passing one synthetic family does not establish domain universality or validate the universal d_crit=4 reference.
